required_wording: This Bc pilot uses the frozen protocol-faithful reconstructed PN-FP parent dataset because the original historical Ba dataset is permanently unavailable.
The appropriate hard-label comparator is the reconstructed-parent Ba trajectory run, not the original historical Ba endpoint.
strict_comparability_to_reconstructed_pa: YES, subject to unchanged training protocol except KD objective

forecast.proxy_source: Active Cross-Lineage Bb actual training_exit/evaluation_exit/archive_pipeline_launch/archive_pipeline_exit and final gate timestamps
limitations: Timing estimates extrapolate PNFP short-response workload; other five datasets may have different sequence lengths.
Overhead uses previous Qwen campaign as operational proxy, not measured Llama Bc detector/utility/archive runtime.
No model save/checkpoint write measured; future save/retention policy may add time.
All 100steps are within225step LRwarmup; ten timing burn-in steps are separate.

Original historical Ba timing unavailable; reconstructed trajectory comparison uses sum of on_step_begin/on_step_end durations, excludes detector checkpoints but includes different telemetry overhead.
Native dynamic-date template unchanged as code; rendered calendar date differs from prior trajectory.
